detail.title: An Adaptive Multi-Scale Multi-Expert Hybrid Deep Learning Framework for Early Breast Cancer Histopathological Image Analysis
detail.abstract: Breast cancer is one of the leading causes of cancer-related mortality among women worldwide, making accurate histopathological image analysis essential for early diagnosis and effective treatment of the disease. However, most existing deep learning approaches rely on single-scale feature extraction or a single network architecture, limiting their ability to simultaneously capture fine-grained cellular details and the global tissue context. To address these challenges, this study proposes an Adaptive Multi-Scale Multi-Expert Hybrid Deep Learning Framework for breast cancer histopathological image classification. The proposed framework employs multi-scale image representations to preserve morphological information at different spatial resolutions, while EfficientNetB7 extracts discriminative local features, and Vision Transformer (ViTB/16) learns long-range contextual dependencies. An adaptive multilayer perceptron (MLP)-based fusion mechanism dynamically integrates complementary features from both expert networks, followed by an attention refinement module to enhance the diagnostically significant representations. The framework was evaluated on the publicly available BreakHis dataset, which comprises eight breast cancer histopathological subtypes. The experimental results demonstrate an accuracy of 98.4%, precision of 98.3%, and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 99.7%, outperforming several state-of-the-art methods. Furthermore, Grad-CAM provides interpretable visual explanations, enhancing the transparency and clinical applicability of the proposed computer-aided diagnostic system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自适应多尺度多专家混合深度学习框架（AMSMH-DLF），用于乳腺癌组织病理图像分类。该框架结合EfficientNetB7提取局部特征和ViTB/16学习长程上下文依赖，通过自适应MLP融合机制和注意力精炼模块整合互补特征，在BreakHis数据集上达到了98.4%的准确率，优于多种现有方法。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够同时捕捉细粒度细胞细节和全局组织上下文的深度学习框架，以实现更准确的乳腺癌组织病理图像分类？
AI.motivation: 乳腺癌是全球女性癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一，准确的病理图像分析对早期诊断和治疗至关重要。然而，现有深度学习方法大多依赖单尺度特征提取或单一网络架构，难以同时捕捉细粒度细胞细节和全局组织上下文信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多尺度图像表示理论、多专家混合（Mixture of Experts）架构、卷积神经网络（CNN）与视觉Transformer（ViT）的互补特征学习理论
AI.method: 提出自适应多尺度多专家混合深度学习框架：1) 使用多尺度图像表示保留不同空间分辨率的形态学信息；2) EfficientNetB7提取判别性局部特征，ViTB/16学习长程上下文依赖；3) 基于自适应MLP的融合机制动态整合两个专家网络的互补特征；4) 注意力精炼模块增强诊断显著表征；5) 使用Grad-CAM提供可解释性视觉解释。
AI.findings: 在BreakHis数据集（包含八种乳腺癌组织病理亚型）上，框架达到98.4%的准确率、98.3%的精确率和99.7%的AUC，优于多种最先进方法；Grad-CAM可视化为系统提供了可解释性和临床适用性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 验证了多尺度表示与多专家混合架构在病理图像分析中的协同效应；2) 证明了CNN与Transformer互补特征融合的有效性；3) 提出了自适应MLP融合机制和注意力精炼模块，为多专家系统设计提供了新思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为乳腺癌计算机辅助诊断提供了高性能且可解释的深度学习框架；2) Grad-CAM可视化增强了临床医生的信任度和系统透明度；3) 在公开数据集上的优异表现表明其具有临床部署的潜力。

title: Colorimeter-Supervised Skin Tone Estimation from Dermatoscopic Images for Fairness Auditing

detail.title: Colorimeter-Supervised Skin Tone Estimation from Dermatoscopic Images for Fairness Auditing
detail.abstract: Neural-network–based diagnosis from dermatoscopic images is increasingly used for clinical decision support, yet studies report performance disparities across skin tones. Fairness auditing of these models is limited by the lack of reliable skin-tone annotations in public dermatoscopy datasets. We address this gap with neural networks that predict Fitzpatrick skin type via ordinal regression and the Individual Typology Angle (ITA) via color regression, using in-person Fitzpatrick labels and colorimeter measurements as targets. We further leverage extensive pretraining on synthetic and real dermatoscopic and clinical images. The Fitzpatrick model achieves agreement comparable to human crowdsourced annotations, and ITA predictions show high concordance with colorimeter-derived ITA, substantially outperforming pixel-averaging approaches. Applying these estimators to ISIC 2020 and MILK10k, we find that fewer than 1\% of subjects belong to Fitzpatrick types V and VI. We release code and pretrained models as an open-source tool for rapid skin-tone annotation and bias auditing. This is, to our knowledge, the first dermatoscopic skin-tone estimation neural network validated against colorimeter measurements, and it supports growing evidence of clinically relevant performance gaps across skin-tone groups.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了基于神经网络的皮肤色调估计工具，通过序数回归预测Fitzpatrick皮肤类型、通过颜色回归预测ITA值，以解决皮肤镜数据集中缺乏可靠皮肤色调标注的问题，从而支持公平性审计。
AI.research_question: 如何利用神经网络从皮肤镜图像中准确估计皮肤色调（Fitzpatrick皮肤类型和ITA值），以支持对皮肤镜诊断模型的公平性审计？
AI.motivation: 基于神经网络的皮肤镜诊断模型在不同肤色间存在性能差异，但公平性审计受限于公共皮肤镜数据集中缺乏可靠的皮肤色调标注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 序数回归（用于Fitzpatrick皮肤类型预测）、颜色回归（用于ITA预测）、迁移学习/预训练策略
AI.method: 利用神经网络分别通过序数回归预测Fitzpatrick皮肤类型、通过颜色回归预测ITA值，使用面对面Fitzpatrick标签和色度计测量值作为目标值，并在合成数据及真实皮肤镜和临床图像上进行大规模预训练。
AI.findings: Fitzpatrick模型预测与人类众包标注一致性相当；ITA预测与色度计导出的ITA高度一致，显著优于像素平均法；在ISIC 2020和MILK10k数据集中，Fitzpatrick V和VI型受试者占比不足1%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首个经色度计测量验证的皮肤镜皮肤色调估计神经网络，为皮肤色调估计提供了可验证的基准方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 发布了代码和预训练模型作为开源工具，可用于快速皮肤色调标注和偏差审计，支持识别不同肤色群体间临床相关的性能差异。

title: Dividing Digital Dollars: How The Genius and Clarity Acts Shape Competition Among Stablecoins, Tokenized Treasuries, and Tokenized Bank Deposits

detail.title: Dividing Digital Dollars: How The Genius and Clarity Acts Shape Competition Among Stablecoins, Tokenized Treasuries, and Tokenized Bank Deposits
detail.abstract: The GENIUS Act and the pending CLARITY Act together define the competitive landscape for digital money in the United States. This article examines how these acts would allocate market power among three instruments: payment stablecoins, tokenized Treasury funds, and tokenized bank deposits. Each performs cash-like functions on blockchain networks, yet each operates under a distinct regulatory and balance-sheet architecture. The GENIUS Act has already segmented the market by prohibiting stablecoin issuers from paying yield, which pushes returnseeking capital toward tokenized Treasury funds and interest-bearing tokenized deposits. The CLARITY Act, if enacted, would intensify this competition by clarifying SEC-CFTC jurisdiction and expanding participation by regulated banks and asset managers. I develop a regulatory competition framework that evaluates these instruments across five dimensions: regulatory certainty, yield potential, settlement efficiency, institutional integration, and systemic implications. The analysis suggests that the interaction of the two statutes, rather than either alone, will determine which institutions intermediate digital liquidity. The result is likely to be specialization rather than convergence: stablecoins for payments, tokenized Treasuries for yield, and tokenized deposits for regulated credit creation. These findings carry implications for banking disintermediation, capital allocation, and the future structure of U.S. digital finance.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了《GENIUS法案》和《CLARITY法案》如何共同塑造美国数字货币的竞争格局，通过提出监管竞争框架，评估支付型稳定币、代币化国债基金和代币化银行存款这三类数字工具在五个维度上的竞争态势，并预测最终将形成专业化分工而非融合的市场结构。
AI.research_question: 《GENIUS法案》和《CLARITY法案》将如何在支付型稳定币、代币化国债基金和代币化银行存款之间分配市场权力？两项法案的相互作用将如何决定数字流动性的中介结构？
AI.motivation: 美国数字支付领域正面临缺乏明确监管框架的局面，现有文献尚未系统分析两项关键法案（GENIUS和CLARITY）对数字资产市场竞争格局的联合影响。随着稳定币市场快速增长，理解监管立法如何重塑不同数字货币工具的竞争边界，对银行业、资本配置及数字金融的未来结构具有重要理论和现实意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管竞争框架（regulatory competition framework），从监管确定性、收益潜力、结算效率、机构整合和系统性影响五个维度对三类数字货币工具进行比较分析。
AI.method: 定性制度分析，基于监管竞争框架对两项法案的条款及其市场影响进行多维度比较分析。
AI.findings: 1) GENIUS法案通过禁止稳定币发行方支付收益，已将市场分割：收益导向资本流向代币化国债基金和计息代币化存款；2) CLARITY法案若通过，将通过明确SEC-CFTC管辖权并扩大受监管银行和资产管理公司的参与，加剧竞争；3) 两项法规的相互作用而非单独任一法规将决定数字流动性的中介格局；4) 最终结果可能是专业化而非趋同：稳定币主导支付、代币化国债主导收益、代币化存款主导受监管信贷创造。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个新的"监管竞争框架"，将监管立法作为分配市场权力的结构性力量来分析数字金融资产之间的竞争关系，弥补了现有研究仅关注单一法案或单一资产类别、忽略法规交互效应的不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、银行机构、资产管理公司和稳定币发行方提供了关于美国数字金融立法影响的系统性评估，有助于各方预判监管变化带来的市场格局调整，并为银行业去中介化风险管理和资本配置决策提供参考依据。

title: Unidentifiable by Design The Limits of Self-Auditing in Co-Evolving Agent-Regulator Systems

detail.title: Unidentifiable by Design The Limits of Self-Auditing in Co-Evolving Agent-Regulator Systems
detail.abstract: Evaluating whether a governance policy changed an adaptive agent's behavior is a policy-evaluation problem, and it inherits a classical obstruction. A market allocates without any participant knowing its structural parameters, because exogenous variation continually reveals them; a closed governance loop has a market's imperfect information but not its variation, since the regulator sets the policy and the only response it observes is produced by agents adapting to that policy. Such a loop cannot diagnose its own effect from its own record. This is the Lucas (1976) critique on the incentive side and Hayek's (1945) knowledge problem on the measurement side, made precise for the governance of artificial agents. We operated a governance layer for a large-language-model coding agent-mechanical rules, an incident register, and a behavioral metric-and asked whether it worked. Over sixteen days the metric, the rate at which the agent opened a task with a specific structured lookup rather than a generic search, rose from 50% to 87.3%; the obvious reading credits the rules. We could not establish it. Over the same window the model generation was upgraded and the task mix shifted at one fleet-wide boundary, and enforcement is itself a function of the agent's prior behavior. Under these two conditions the causal effect of enforcement is not point-identified: the identified set is the no-assumption partial-identification bound, here-17.5 to +82.5 percentage points-a Manski width of 100.0 against a naive +37.3 estimate that sits uninformatively inside it. The map from behavioral trajectory to recorded metric is non-invertible, so no post-hoc stratification recovers what the aggregate discarded-true even of a flawless classifier. A third channel appears only because the system was studied: sessions auditing the metric's own instrument flipped its classifications at 6.3 times the organic rate, a deterministic, mechanism-level cousin of the Hawthorne effect whose direction we predict from the shape of the probe. The obstruction is structural, not an artifact of small samples or lost logs-one deployed instance of a barrier no internal record can lift. The remedy is the exogenous variation the loop does not generate: a randomized factorial validation slice that acts as a synthetic market, manufacturing the instrument atomic rollout destroys. One quantity escapes the causal obstruction-a within-session self-correction rate, identified precisely because it attributes nothing-though it remains subject to the measurement obstruction and requires a non-reflexive channel our own artifact does not yet fully provide. We release a reproducible artifact, including an explicit disclosure of what it does not yet compute, so that the paper's own empirical claims are discharged by a script the reader runs rather than by assertion.

AI.tldr: 本文研究治理政策评估在自适应智能体环境中的根本性障碍：闭环治理系统无法仅凭自身记录诊断其政策效果（卢卡斯批判与哈耶克知识问题的精确化）。通过对大型语言模型编码智能体的治理实验（16天，行为指标从50%升至87.3%），作者证明因果效应无法点识别，识别集宽度达100个百分点，并提出随机化析因验证切片作为"合成市场"的补救方案。
AI.research_question: 如何评估治理政策是否真的改变了自适应智能体（特别是LLM编码智能体）的行为？闭环治理系统能否仅凭自身观测记录识别政策的因果效应？
AI.motivation: 治理政策评估是政策评估问题的经典难题。在自适应智能体环境中，这一难题被放大：市场参与者可通过外生变异学习结构参数，但闭环治理系统中监管者设定政策，观察到的唯一响应是智能体适应政策的产物，因此系统无法从自身记录诊断自身效果。作者希望将该问题形式化并实证展示其不可回避性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 卢卡斯（1976）批判——政策变化改变经济主体行为参数导致的评估无效性；哈耶克（1945）知识问题——分散知识的不可集中性在测量端的体现；部分识别理论（Manski bounds）；霍桑效应的机制级推广。
AI.method: 作者为LLM编码智能体运行了一个治理层（机械规则、事件登记册、行为指标），进行16天实地实验。使用部分识别方法（无假设界限）分析因果效应识别集；通过模拟"探针"审计揭示测量通道的霍桑效应；提出随机化析因验证切片（randomized factorial validation slice）作为外生变异来源的补救设计；并发布可复现的伪影（artifact）。
AI.findings: （1）治理指标从50%升至87.3%，但因果效应无法点识别：识别集为-17.5至+82.5个百分点（宽度100.0），而朴素估计+37.3落在其中、无信息量；（2）行为轨迹到记录指标的映射不可逆，事后分层无法恢复聚合丢失的信息；（3）审计测量工具的会话将分类翻转率提高至有机率的6.3倍（机制级霍桑效应）；（4）唯一可识别的是会话内自我纠错率，因为它不做任何归因。
AI.theory_contributions: 将卢卡斯批判和哈耶克知识问题精确化到治理AI智能体的语境，证明闭环治理的因果识别障碍是结构性的而非数据问题；形式化展示行为轨迹-记录指标映射不可逆性对事后分层的根本限制；引入"机制级霍桑效应"概念并将其方向预测与探针形状关联。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出随机化析因验证切片作为"合成市场"的识别方案，为AI治理系统提供了可操作的外生变异生成方法；发布可复现伪影并将实证声明的验证交给读者运行的脚本来完成，倡导可复现性实践；为AI治理政策评估提供明确的识别界限和补救路径。

title: Effective Sales Strategies for Prosumers in Mobile C2C Secondhand Marketplaces: A Mixed-Methods Study Based on Firsthand Selling Experiences and Survey Data

detail.title: Effective Sales Strategies for Prosumers in Mobile C2C Secondhand Marketplaces: A Mixed-Methods Study Based on Firsthand Selling Experiences and Survey Data

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The survey phase of this study (Step 3) did not undergo formal Institutional Review Board (IRB) review; however, it adhered to ethical principles for human subject research. Conducted in South Korea, the anonymous survey collected no personally identifiable or sensitive information, ensuring minimal risk to participants. Before participation, respondents were informed of the research purpose and data utilization plans, and provided voluntary informed consent prior to completing the questionnaire.

detail.abstract: The rapid growth of the mobile consumer-to-consumer (C2C) secondhand marketplace has expanded the role of prosumers (both buyers and sellers) and intensified competition among sellers. Accordingly, this study aimed to develop and validate effective sales strategies to enhance the transaction competitiveness of prosumer sellers. This study employed a seller-centered sequential exploratory mixed-methods design consisting of three steps: (1) extracting practical insights from firsthand prosumer seller experiences through autoethnographic and statistical analyses, (2) developing sales strategies based on literature integration, and (3) validating these strategies through consumer surveys and multiple linear regression analysis. The resulting seven strategies were structured into a chronological framework conceptualized in this study as the "Prosumer Seller Journey." The empirical analysis in Step 1 compared sales performance before and after strategy implementation using 90 comparable product listings across seven categories over two years, demonstrating statistically significant improvements following the application of the proposed strategies. In Step 3, survey responses from 300 C2C mobile secondhand marketplace users demonstrated the significant effects of the seven strategies on purchase intention through multiple linear regression analysis (p < .05). Moreover, this study revealed that exposure to structured sales strategies reshaped consumers' perceptions of purchase determinants. While price reduction and payment security were initially considered the primary factors, consumers subsequently recognized previously overlooked factors, including attractive product displays and optimized exposure timing and frequency, as more influential drivers of purchase intention. These findings provide empirically validated sales strategies to enhance prosumer competitiveness in the rapidly growing C2C secondhand marketplace, while offering practical insights for user-centered platform improvements and potentially supporting the future advancement of mobile C2C secondhand marketplaces.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用分三步的探索性序贯混合方法设计，通过自民族志与统计分析、文献整合、消费者调查与多元线性回归，开发并验证了七种销售策略，并提出"产消者卖家旅程"时间框架，用以提升移动C2C二手市场中产消者卖家的交易竞争力。
AI.research_question: 如何开发并验证有效的销售策略，以提升移动C2C二手市场中产消者卖家的交易竞争力？
AI.motivation: 移动C2C二手市场快速增长，产消者（兼具买卖双方角色）的作用扩大，卖家间竞争加剧，但缺乏系统性的、经过实证验证的销售策略来帮助产消者卖家提升交易竞争力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产消者（Prosumer）理论；销售策略与购买意向相关理论；卖家中心视角的探索性序贯混合方法框架。
AI.method: 三步骤探索性序贯混合方法设计：(1)通过自民族志与统计分析提取实践洞见（比较90个可比商品列表在策略实施前后的销售表现，涵盖7个品类、2年数据）；(2)基于文献整合开发七种销售策略；(3)通过300名移动C2C二手市场用户的问卷调查与多元线性回归分析验证策略效果（p<.05）。
AI.findings: 七种销售策略均对购买意向产生显著影响；策略实施后销售表现显著提升；此外，接触结构化销售策略改变了消费者对购买决定因素的认知——从最初关注降价和支付安全，转向认可产品展示吸引力、曝光时机与频率等先前被忽略的因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"产消者卖家旅程"（Prosumer Seller Journey）这一新的时间维度概念框架；揭示了结构化销售策略对消费者购买决定因素认知的重塑效应，丰富了产消者销售策略与购买意向关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为产消者卖家提供了七种经实证验证的销售策略，提升其在C2C二手市场的竞争力；为用户中心的平台改进提供实践洞见；支持移动C2C二手市场的未来发展。

title: Excessive Monitoring in Hierarchical Organizations
affiliations: Nanyang Technological University (NTU) - Division of Economics and Nanyang Technological University

detail.title: Excessive Monitoring in Hierarchical Organizations
detail.abstract: Why do hierarchies devote too much capacity to supervision? We develop a principalsupervisor-agent model in which monitoring produces information but also constrains frontline production. Monitoring has a productive return and an appropriative return: by revealing private information, it allows the principal to reduce the agent's informational rent. Because rent recovery benefits the principal but is an internal transfer in aggregate organizational surplus, the principal induces excessive monitoring even when supervision is socially valuable. In the benchmark, monitoring reduces the agent's feasible effort set; when supervisory capacity is endogenous, the same mechanism produces an oversized monitoring layer. The result also holds when monitoring lowers effort effectiveness rather than feasible effort. Thus, a monitoring unit can perform its assigned task efficiently while making the organization less productive.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个委托人-监督者-代理人模型，论证了层级组织为何会将过多资源投入监督活动。监督不仅产生信息，还限制了前线生产。监督具有生产性回报（提高产出）和攫取性回报（通过揭示私人信息减少代理人的信息租金）。由于租金回收有利于委托人但属于组织总盈余中的内部转移，即使监督具有社会价值，委托人也会诱导过度监督。当监督能力内生时，这一机制会产生过大的监督层级。
AI.research_question: 为什么层级组织会将过多的能力（capacity）投入监督活动？即过度监督的组织根源是什么？
AI.motivation: 现实中观察到的组织普遍存在监督过度扩张现象，但现有理论未能充分解释这一现象的组织内部机制。论文旨在揭示监督同时具有生产性功能和攫取性（分配性）功能，后者导致委托人系统性偏好过度监督。
AI.theoretical_framework: 委托-代理理论、信息经济学、组织层级理论。核心概念包括：信息租金、监督的生产性回报与攫取性回报、组织总盈余与内部转移的区分。
AI.method: 构建委托人-监督者-代理人三层级理论模型。基准模型中监督减少代理人可行努力集合；在扩展模型中考察监督能力内生化的情形，以及监督降低努力效率（而非可行努力）的替代设定。
AI.findings: （1）委托人会诱导过度监督，即使监督本身具有社会价值；（2）原因在于监督的租金攫取效应是对组织总盈余而言的内部转移，但委托人可从中获益；（3）当监督能力内生时，会产生过大的监督层级；（4）该结论在监督降低努力效率而非可行努力时仍然成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次严格区分监督的生产性回报与攫取性回报，揭示了过度监督的组织内部根源；表明即使监督单位自身高效完成任务，仍可能降低组织整体生产率，为组织层级理论提供了新见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解组织层级膨胀、官僚主义监督扩张提供了理论解释；提示管理者在评估监督部门效率时应关注其分配性功能对组织总盈余的影响，而非仅看监督部门自身的任务完成情况。

title: Cyber-Physical Resilience Engineering: A Proposed Framework for Physics-Informed Mission Assurance in Critical Infrastructure

detail.title: Cyber-Physical Resilience Engineering: A Proposed Framework for Physics-Informed Mission Assurance in Critical Infrastructure
detail.abstract: Critical infrastructure protection practice in the United States is anchored in cybersecurity frameworks, most recently the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency's (CISA) Cross-Sector Cybersecurity Performance Goals (CPG) version 2.0 and the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0, that measure the trustworthiness of digital systems. These frameworks are necessary but not sufficient for infrastructure operators, whose ultimate concern is whether the physical mission (treating water, delivering power, moving trains) can still be trusted during and after a cyber-physical disturbance. Cybersecurity tells us whether digital systems can be trusted; engineering tells us whether physical systems are operating correctly; operators need both perspectives simultaneously. This paper introduces Cyber-Physical Resilience Engineering (CPRE), a proposed engineering framework that integrates cybersecurity telemetry, control systems engineering, and physicsbased validation to support mission assurance and operational resilience. We define four functional pillars (physics-based validation, trust quantification, mission assurance measurement, and integrated resilience operations) and their associated metrics: Trust Confidence, Process Integrity, and the Mission Assurance Index (MAI). We then present a complementary mapping of CPRE metrics to CPG 2.0 goals across the six CSF 2.0 functions, and an instantiation table across all sixteen DHS-designated critical infrastructure sectors. We conclude by arguing that the sector should extend, not abandon, compliance-based posture toward prospective resilience engineering: continuously answering, in engineering terms, whether the mission can be trusted now and under credible future disturbance. The framework is offered as an open research agenda, and critique from the systems engineering, control systems, and infrastructure protection communities is explicitly invited.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"网络物理弹性工程"（CPRE）框架，将网络安全遥测、控制系统工程和基于物理的验证相结合，以支持基础设施运营商的使命保障和运营弹性，并定义了四个功能支柱（基于物理的验证、信任量化、使命保障测量、综合弹性运营）及三个核心指标（信任置信度、过程完整性、使命保障指数），同时提供了与CISA CPG 2.0和NIST CSF 2.0的映射关系以及覆盖美国16个关键基础设施部门的实例化表格。
AI.research_question: 如何在现有网络安全框架（CISA CPG 2.0和NIST CSF 2.0）的基础上，构建一个集成网络安全与物理系统工程视角的框架，使关键基础设施运营商能够在网络物理扰动期间和之后持续评估物理使命（如水处理、电力输送、轨道交通）的可信性？
AI.motivation: 现有的网络安全框架（如CISA CPG 2.0和NIST CSF 2.0）仅衡量数字系统的可信性，但基础设施运营商真正关心的是物理使命能否在遭受网络物理扰动时和之后依然可靠运行。网络安全与工程视角的割裂导致运营商无法同时获知"数字系统是否可信"和"物理系统是否正常运行"两个维度，因此需要一个新的综合框架来弥合这一鸿沟。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于网络物理系统（CPS）理论和弹性工程（Resilience Engineering）理论，整合了网络安全框架（NIST CSF 2.0、CISA CPG 2.0）、控制系统工程以及基于物理的验证方法，构建了跨学科的CPRE框架。
AI.method: 本文采用框架构建与概念映射的方法：首先定义CPRE的四个功能支柱和三个核心指标；然后进行CPRE指标与CPG 2.0目标在CSF 2.0六个功能维度上的映射分析；最后构建覆盖DHS指定的16个关键基础设施部门的实例化表格。
AI.findings: CPRE框架成功地将网络安全指标与物理工程指标整合到一个统一框架中，通过信任置信度、过程完整性和使命保障指数三个指标实现跨学科集成；完成了与CPG 2.0和CSF 2.0的互补映射，证明了CPRE是对现有合规导向框架的扩展而非替代；并在全部16个关键基础设施部门中提供了可实例化的实施路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文提出了网络物理弹性工程（CPRE）这一新的理论框架概念，弥合了网络安全学科与物理工程学科之间的理论鸿沟，为关键基础设施保护提供了从"合规导向"向"前瞻性弹性工程"转变的理论基础，丰富了弹性工程在网络物理系统领域的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为关键基础设施运营商提供了可操作的CPRE框架，包括四个功能支柱和三个量化指标（MAI、信任置信度、过程完整性），以及与现有合规框架（CPG 2.0/CSF 2.0）的映射指南和16个部门的实例化表格，帮助运营商在实际运营中同时监控网络和物理层面的可信性。

title: Hours by Design: Job Menus and the Limits of Hours Choice

detail.title: Hours by Design: Job Menus and the Limits of Hours Choice
detail.abstract: Many American workers do not work their preferred hours, yet standard models treat hours constraints as exogenous and leave unmodeled the firms that decide which hours to offer. I develop a dynamic structural model in which firms post discrete job menus, bundles of weekly hours and scheduling regimes, and estimate the worker side of that model on SIPP data, taking the observed distribution of menus as given. Roughly 82% of workers cannot obtain their preferred weekly hours from their employer's menu. A welfare decomposition attributes almost the entire distortion to menu restriction rather than to the nonlinear wage. Since workers' choices are in the corners, the wage nonlinearity channel is near zero. This result is robust to the dispersion of preference heterogeneity. A full-menu benchmark bounds the welfare gain from menu expansion at 16.8% of permanent consumption. The results speak to fair scheduling legislation and remote work policy.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个动态结构模型，其中企业发布离散的工作菜单（每周工时与排班制度的组合），并利用SIPP数据估计工人的选择行为。研究发现约82%的工人无法从雇主菜单中获得其偏好的每周工时，福利分解表明几乎全部扭曲源于菜单限制而非非线性工资。全面菜单基准下，菜单扩张的福利收益上界为永久消费的16.8%，研究结果对公平排班立法和远程工作政策具有启示意义。
AI.research_question: 工人无法获得理想工时的主要根源是什么？是菜单限制（企业提供的工时选项有限）还是非线性工资造成的？其福利影响有多大？
AI.motivation: 许多美国工人无法工作其偏好的工时，但标准模型将工时限制视为外生给定，且未对企业决定提供何种工时的行为进行建模。这一缺口导致对工时扭曲来源及福利损失的误解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态结构模型；企业发布离散工作菜单（每周工时与排班制度的组合）；工人侧选择模型的估计
AI.method: 构建企业发布离散工作菜单的动态结构模型，利用SIPP（收入与项目参与调查）数据估计工人侧模型，将观察到的菜单分布视为给定，并进行福利分解分析及全面菜单基准的福利上界估算。
AI.findings: （1）约82%的工人无法从其雇主的菜单中获得偏好的每周工时；（2）福利分解显示几乎全部扭曲源于菜单限制，而非非线性工资，因为工人选择处于角点解，工资非线性渠道效应接近于零；（3）该结果对偏好异质性的分散程度具有稳健性；（4）全面菜单基准下，菜单扩张的福利收益上界为永久消费的16.8%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将工时限制内生化，首次将企业提供的工时菜单视为内生的结构性变量而非外生约束；通过福利分解厘清了菜单限制与非线性工资两种扭曲渠道的相对重要性；识别出工人选择处于角点解导致工资非线性渠道接近于零这一重要机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公平排班立法提供量化依据，表明菜单扩张可带来相当于永久消费16.8%的福利收益上限；为远程工作政策提供参考，因为不同工作安排的菜单提供影响工人的工时满意度；帮助企业理解其工时供给决策对工人福利的影响。

title: Sterilized Foreign Exchange Intervention
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), Sogang University and Sogang University

detail.title: Sterilized Foreign Exchange Intervention
detail.abstract: In this paper, we study the effectiveness of foreign exchange intervention (FXI) as a policy tool against volatile capital flows. In particular, we focus on a key institutional feature of FXI: In many countries, FXIs are sterilized in that foreign currency trades by the authorities are accompanied by corresponding transactions in domestic currency-denominated bonds. We find that the effectiveness of FXI critically depends on the substitutability between the assets held by foreign investors and the bonds used for sterilization, in the presence of financial frictions in domestic capital markets. We also explore the effectiveness of various intervention rules. Broadly speaking, intervention rules that do not overly suppress necessary exchange rate adjustments appear more effective. Our findings suggest that the role of FXI is not to reverse exchange rate movements that appear disconnected from fundamentals, but rather to grease the wheels of market intermediation by private investors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究外汇干预（FXI）作为应对资本流动波动的政策工具的有效性，重点关注外汇干预的冲销机制这一关键制度特征。研究发现，在存在国内资本市场金融摩擦的情况下，FXI的有效性关键取决于外国投资者持有的资产与用于冲销的本币债券之间的可替代性。研究还探索了各类干预规则的有效性，总体而言，不过度抑制必要汇率调整的干预规则更为有效。研究结果表明，FXI的作用并非逆转与基本面脱节的汇率变动，而是润滑私人投资者市场中介的"车轮"。
AI.research_question: 在资本流动波动背景下，外汇干预（FXI）作为政策工具的有效性如何？其有效性受哪些制度特征和条件影响？不同的干预规则效果有何差异？
AI.motivation: 外汇干预在各国实践中普遍采用冲销形式（伴随本币债券交易），但这一关键制度特征对FXI有效性的影响尚未得到充分研究；同时，现有文献对FXI能否有效应对资本流动波动存在争议，需要系统分析其发挥作用的条件和边界。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于引入国内资本市场金融摩擦的开放经济模型，分析冲销型外汇干预的传导机制，考察资产可替代性与金融摩擦对干预效果的交互作用。
AI.method: 构建带有国内资本市场金融摩擦的理论模型，通过比较静态分析研究冲销型外汇干预的效果，并模拟评估不同干预规则的有效性。
AI.findings: （1）FXI的有效性关键取决于外国投资者持有的资产与冲销债券之间的可替代性，尤其在存在国内金融摩擦时；（2）不过度抑制必要汇率调整的干预规则更为有效；（3）FXI的正确角色是润滑市场中介，而非逆转与基本面脱节的汇率变动。
AI.theory_contributions: 将冲销这一制度细节纳入外汇干预有效性分析，揭示了资产可替代性和金融摩擦是决定FXI效果的关键机制；重新框定了FXI的政策功能定位，从"逆转汇率"转向"润滑市场中介"。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了冲销型外汇干预有效性的适用条件，并为选择具体的干预规则提供指导，即应避免过度抑制汇率的必要调整。

title: A Survey of the Challenges Faced by Social Science Teachers in Teaching at the Secondary Stage
affiliations: and Regional Institute of Education, Bhubaneswar

detail.title: A Survey of the Challenges Faced by Social Science Teachers in Teaching at the Secondary Stage
detail.abstract: This mixed-methods study investigated secondary social science teachers’ perspectives on student engagement and classroom management challenges in CBSE and BSEaffiliated schools of Odisha. Despite the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020’s emphasis on experiential, competency-based, and student-centred learning, ground realities in Odisha’s secondary classrooms continue to reflect persistent gaps between policy vision and classroom practice. The study addressed this disconnect by foregrounding teachers’ voices in four coastal districts (Khordha, Puri, Cuttack, and Jajpur). A sequential explanatory design was employed. In Phase I, a researcherdeveloped 24-item, 5-point Likert-scale questionnaire was administered to 120 social science teachers (60 CBSE and 60 BSE) teaching Classes 9–10. The composite total score (combining student engagement challenges and classroom management effectiveness) was analysed using descriptive statistics, tests of normality, Pearson correlation, and independent samples t-tests. Phase II involved semi-structured interviews with 10 purposively selected teachers (5 from each board), analysed through Braun and Clarke’s (2006) thematic analysis. Quantitative findings revealed a moderate level of perceived challenges (M = 77.63, SD = 13.22). The distribution was approximately normal with mild positive skew. Among the five objectives, only class size emerged as statistically significant: teachers handling classes above 50 students reported significantly higher challenges (M = 80.32) than those with classes below 50 (M = 74.95), t(118) = –2.262, p = .026. No significant relationships were found between perceived challenges and years of teaching experience (r = .159, p = .083), academic qualifications (r = –.006, p = .951), school board affiliation (t(118) = –1.514, p = .133), or participation in professional development programmes (t(118) = 0.063, p = .950). Item-level analysis highlighted behavioural issues, passive engagement, low teacher self-efficacy in classroom management, and large class sizes as dominant concerns. Qualitative themes enriched the statistical results and aligned with the five objectives. Teachers reported a gradual shift from lecture-based to interactive, locally contextualised methods with experience, yet noted rigidity and digital distractions. Higher qualifications enhanced content depth but practical skills and rapport mattered more. Clear differences emerged between CBSE (activity-oriented, confident students) and BSE (rote-learning, language barriers, resource constraints) systems. Professional development offered useful techniques but suffered from short duration and poor contextual adaptation. Large classes severely restricted individual attention and interactive pedagogies, while smaller classes enabled higher participation. The study concludes that structural factors, particularly large class sizes, exert the strongest influence on teachers’ perceived challenges in Odisha. Moderate overall difficulties, combined with a pronounced self-efficacy gap in classroom management, underscore the need for targeted interventions. The findings strongly recommend sustained, schoolbased professional development through Professional Learning Communities, culturally responsive and art-integrated pedagogies, enforceable class-size norms, and greater contextualisation of the curriculum using Odisha’s local history and realities. This research contributes to the limited body of Odisha-specific literature by centring teachers’ lived experiences. It offers actionable insights for SCERT, DIETs, school administrators, and policymakers to bridge the gap between NEP 2020’s transformative vision and classroom realities, ultimately fostering more engaging, inclusive, and effective Social Science education across the state.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用混合方法调查了奥里萨邦CBSE和BSE附属中学社会科学教师对学生参与度和课堂管理挑战的看法。量化阶段（120名教师问卷）显示挑战总体处于中等水平，班级规模是唯一显著影响因素；质性阶段（10名教师访谈）进一步揭示了被动参与、教师自我效能感不足、大班额限制等核心问题。研究建议通过校本专业学习社群、文化回应式教学和可执行的班额规范来弥合政策与课堂实践的差距。
AI.research_question: 奥里萨邦CBSE和BSE附属中学社会科学教师对学生参与度和课堂管理挑战的看法是什么？结构因素（如班级规模）和经验因素如何影响这些挑战？
AI.motivation: 尽管NEP 2020强调体验式、能力本位和学生中心学习，但奥里萨邦中学课堂的实际情况仍与政策愿景存在持续差距，而教师的声音在该地区研究中长期被忽视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于NEP 2020政策框架、教师自我效能感理论、混合研究方法论中的序列解释设计，以及Braun和Clarke的主题分析框架。
AI.method: 混合方法研究：采用序列解释设计。第一阶段对120名社会科学教师（60名CBSE、60名BSE）施测24题5点李克特量表问卷，使用描述统计、正态性检验、皮尔逊相关和独立样本t检验分析；第二阶段对10名目的性抽样教师进行半结构化访谈，采用Braun和Clarke（2006）主题分析法。
AI.findings: 挑战总体处于中等水平（M=77.63, SD=13.22），班级规模是唯一显著因素（50人以上M=80.32 vs 50人以下M=74.95, p=.026）。教龄、学历、学校董事会归属和专业发展参与均无显著关系。质性分析揭示CBSE与BSE系统间的显著差异，大班额严重限制互动教学，教师自我效能感存在明显缺口。
AI.theory_contributions: 为奥里萨邦有限的文献贡献了以教师生活经验为中心的实证证据，将教师声音纳入政策-实践鸿沟的讨论，丰富了印度中学教育背景下教师自我效能感与课堂管理挑战的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为SCERT、DIETs、学校管理者及政策制定者提供了可操作的建议：持续校本专业发展（专业学习社群）、文化回应与艺术整合教学法、可执行的班额规范、基于奥里萨当地历史和现实的课程情境化。

title: The Correlation Between Customer Satisfaction and Employee Engagement in the Hospitality Industry

detail.title: The Correlation Between Customer Satisfaction and Employee Engagement in the Hospitality Industry
detail.abstract: Employee engagement is widely recognized as a key factor influencing organizational performance in service-oriented industries, particularly in hospitality where employees directly interact with customers. The attitudes, motivation, and involvement of employees significantly shape customer experiences and satisfaction. While previous studies have examined service quality and customer satisfaction extensively, limited research has explored the direct relationship between employee engagement and customer satisfaction in hospitality contexts. This study investigates this relationship and examines the mediating role of service quality. Using a quantitative approach, survey data were collected from hospitality employees and customers. Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) was applied for analysis. The results indicate that employee engagement positively influences service quality and customer satisfaction, with service quality partially mediating this relationship, highlighting its importance for improving hospitality service performance.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨酒店行业员工敬业度与客户满意度之间的关系，并通过结构方程模型验证服务质量在其中的部分中介作用。结果表明员工敬业度正向影响服务质量和客户满意度，且服务质量起部分中介作用。
AI.research_question: 在酒店服务情境下，员工敬业度与客户满意度之间是否存在直接关系？服务质量是否在其中起中介作用？
AI.motivation: 以往研究大多关注服务质量和客户满意度，但较少有研究直接探索酒店情境下员工敬业度与客户满意度之间的直接关系，存在研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 员工敬业度理论、服务质量理论、客户满意度理论，以及中介效应框架（员工敬业度→服务质量→客户满意度）。
AI.method: 采用定量研究方法，收集酒店员工和客户的问卷调查数据，运用结构方程模型（SEM）进行分析。
AI.findings: 员工敬业度正向影响服务质量和客户满意度；服务质量在员工敬业度与客户满意度之间起到部分中介作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了酒店情境下员工敬业度与客户满意度直接关系研究的空白，并验证了服务质量的中介传导机制，丰富了员工敬业度与客户满意度的理论整合框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为酒店管理者提供了实证依据，表明提升员工敬业度能够通过提高服务质量来增进客户满意度，从而改善酒店服务绩效。

title: Smelling Smoke in the Signal: Wildfire Insurance Moratoria and the Housing Market

detail.title: Smelling Smoke in the Signal: Wildfire Insurance Moratoria and the Housing Market
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether targeted disaster-response policies can act as signals of future risk. I study this question in the context of wildfire insurance moratoria in California-policies intended to protect homeowners from non-renewals. Using a staggered di!erence-in-di!erences design, I show that moratorium designations lead to large and persistent declines in home values that extend beyond the one-year policy window. These e!ects arise even in areas outside fire perimeters, indicating that the designation itself, rather than physical damage alone, drives the decline in prices. Following moratoria, FAIR Plan enrollment and new home listings increase, including outside fire perimeters, suggesting that households revise expectations about future insurance availability. In mortgage markets, overall credit supply remains stable, but lending shifts toward riskier borrowers, as reflected in higher loan-to-value ratios and increased credit-related denials. Altogether, these patterns are consistent with moratorium designations acting as public signals that amplify perceived exposure to future losses.

AI.tldr: 本文研究加州野火保险暂停令（moratorium）这一灾害应对政策是否作为未来风险的公共信号，通过交错双重差分设计发现，暂停令指定会导致房价大幅且持续下跌（甚至超出政策窗口期）、FAIR Plan参保和挂牌量增加、抵押贷款向高风险借款人转移，表明政策本身而非实际损害驱动了市场对风险的重新评估。
AI.research_question: 针对性的灾害应对政策能否作为未来风险的信号？具体而言，加州野火保险暂停令是否通过信号效应影响住房市场、保险市场和抵押贷款市场？
AI.motivation: 灾害应对政策通常被视为保护性措施，但可能无意中向市场传递关于未来风险的信号。理解这一信号效应对于政策设计和风险评估至关重要，尤其是在气候变化加剧的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论（signaling theory）——政策干预不仅是保护机制，还作为公共信息信号，影响市场参与者对未来风险的预期。
AI.method: 采用交错双重差分设计（staggered difference-in-differences），比较暂停令指定区域与非指定区域的房价、保险、信贷结果，并区分火灾影响范围内外区域以隔离政策信号效应。
AI.findings: （1）暂停令指定导致房价大幅且持续下跌，影响延伸至政策窗口期之外；（2）效应在火灾周边区域之外同样存在，表明是政策指定本身而非物理损害驱动价格下跌；（3）暂停令后FAIR Plan参保和新增房屋挂牌增加（包括火灾周边之外）；（4）抵押贷款总体供给稳定，但信贷向高风险借款人转移（LTV比率更高、信贷拒绝增加）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为政策信号理论提供实证证据，表明灾害应对政策不仅是风险管理工具，还可能通过信息传递影响市场参与者的风险预期和行为，从而在实物灾害之外产生独立的经济效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者具有重要启示：设计灾害应对政策时需考虑其信号效应，避免政策无意中加剧市场对风险的感知；对保险公司、贷款机构和购房者等市场主体的风险认知和行为决策具有实务参考价值。

title: Waiting for the Golden Ticket: Endogenous Stigma, Job Queues, and the Two Regimes of a Dual Labor Market

detail.title: Waiting for the Golden Ticket: Endogenous Stigma, Job Queues, and the Two Regimes of a Dual Labor Market
detail.abstract: When employers infer ability from whether a young worker waited or worked, the job ladder and the stigma of secondary jobs become equilibrium objects. We model queues for rationed primary jobs in which the scar on a secondary first job reflects employer inference about the self-selected pool that accepts such jobs. Because families finance waiting and family resources correlate with ability, the inference is self-confirming and supports two stable regimes, one with a working ladder and negligible queuing, the other with a broken ladder in which educated youth wait years for jobs most never obtain. A temporary destruction of promotion paths, our reading of Korea’s 1998 crisis, moves the economy permanently to the broken-ladder regime; a pooling mandate of about two years moves it back. The calibrated broken-ladder regime reproduces the Korean moments, and panel microdata confirm the scar, the employed-search penalty, and the family financing of queues. Repairing the ladder eliminates 94 percent of the queuing loss, far more than compressing the premium or removing the status penalty, while adding slots merely recruits queuers. Cross-country regressions of youth idleness on wage premia fail an age placebo and cannot detect such mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个关于初级劳动力市场排队（queuing）的模型，其中雇主从年轻工人是“等待”还是“工作”的选择中推断其能力。次级工作的污名（stigma）成为均衡内生变量。由于家庭为等待提供资金支持，且家庭资源与能力相关，这种推断具有自我确认性质，支撑两种稳定体制：工作阶梯型体制（working ladder）和阶梯断裂型体制（broken ladder）。1998年韩国危机中断了晋升路径，使经济永久性转向阶梯断裂体制；而一项约两年的“合并强制”政策可使之恢复。校准模型重现了韩国的经验特征，面板微观数据证实了污名效应、在职求职惩罚及家庭融资排队现象。修复阶梯可消除94%的排队损失。
AI.research_question: 当雇主从年轻工人是选择等待（排队）还是接受次级工作来推断其能力时，工作阶梯和次级工作的污名如何作为均衡内生变量形成？为什么劳动力市场会陷入一种明知多数人无法获得初级工作却仍长期排队的“断裂阶梯”体制，以及如何修复这种体制？
AI.motivation: 韩国等国家存在大量受过教育的青年长期排队等待初级（优质）工作，宁愿失业也不接受次级工作，造成巨大的经济浪费。现有研究未能解释这种“排队均衡”为何持续存在，以及为何青年非物质激励（如地位、污名）会维持这种均衡。作者希望通过内生化的雇主推断机制来解释这一现象，并探索政策修复路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于以下理论框架：（1）信号与筛选理论（雇主从行为推断能力）；（2）排队/搜寻匹配理论（rationed primary jobs）；（3）自我确认的均衡（self-confirming inference）；（4）多重均衡理论（多重稳定体制）；（5）污名理论（次级工作的社会污名）；（6）家庭融资与代际资源传递理论。
AI.method: （1）理论建模：构建排队均衡模型，将雇主推断、家庭融资、能力分布纳入其中。（2）多重均衡分析：刻画工作阶梯与断裂阶梯两种稳定体制。（3）校准分析：以韩国1998年危机为背景校准断裂阶梯体制。（4）实证检验：使用韩国面板微观数据验证污名效应、在职求职惩罚、家庭融资排队等机制。（5）政策实验：模拟压缩溢价、消除地位惩罚、增加岗位、修复阶梯等政策效果。（6）跨国回归分析：检验青年失业与工资溢价的跨国关系，并进行年龄安慰剂检验。
AI.findings: （1）雇主从“等待”与“工作”的选择推断能力具有自我确认性，产生两种稳定均衡体制。（2）韩国1998年危机对晋升路径的暂时性破坏，使经济持久地转向断裂阶梯体制。（3）约两年的“合并强制”政策可使经济回到工作阶梯体制。（4）校准模型成功再现了韩国青年排队的关键经验特征。（5）面板数据证实了次级工作污名、在职求职惩罚以及家庭融资排队三大机制。（6）修复阶梯可消除94%的排队损失，远优于压缩工资溢价、消除地位惩罚或增加岗位等替代政策（增加岗位只会招募更多排队者）。（7）跨国回归中青年失业与工资溢价的关联无法通过年龄安慰剂检验，说明此类机制难以被简单跨国数据检测。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将次级工作污名内生化为雇主推断的均衡产物，而非外生给定的社会态度。（2）提出“自我确认的推断”机制，解释多重均衡（工作阶梯与断裂阶梯）为何能稳定共存。（3）揭示临时冲击（危机）可通过信念机制产生永久性体制转换（历史的路径依赖）。（4）扩展了排队理论，说明家庭融资如何将能力信号与等待行为耦合。（5）为劳动力市场中“过度教育”和青年长期失业现象提供了新的理论解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提出“修复工作阶梯”作为最优政策方向，表明其效果远优于传统的压缩薪酬溢价、消除地位政策或简单增加岗位数量。（2）警示“增加岗位”政策的陷阱：在断裂阶梯体制下只会吸引更多排队者而非减少排队损失。（3）指出韩国1998年危机造成的青年劳动力市场伤害具有持久性，政策干预窗口（约两年）至关重要。（4）为韩国及其他面临青年大龄就业问题的国家（如南欧、中东）提供了诊断工具和政策修复方案。（5）方法论上警示了跨国简单回归在检测此类机制上的局限（年龄安慰剂检验失败）。

title: Economics of AI Labeling on Social Media Platforms
affiliations: University of Texas at Dallas, Naveen Jindal School of Management, The University of Texas at Dallas, Jindal School of Management and University of Texas at Dallas - Naveen Jindal School of Management

detail.title: Economics of AI Labeling on Social Media Platforms
detail.abstract: Generative AI has blurred the distinction between human-created and AI-generated content in social media, creating uncertainty for consumers who have heterogeneous preferences for the two content types. While some consumers have a strict preference for the content type with which they engage, others have a soft preference such that the content quality shapes the content type they choose to engage with. Simultaneously, human-created content has become an additional revenue source, besides advertisements, for social media platforms because humancreated content has emerged as key training data for AI models. Some platforms have started to label AI-generated content in response to developments in generative AI, an effort that regulators increasingly mandate or promote, even though the identification of a content's true type is imperfect. We study platforms' incentives to label AI-generated content. We find that while labeling can be profitable, it may actually hurt an advertising-driven platform by diminishing consumer engagement. A platform that monetizes human-created content as well may have even less incentive to adopt labeling. Labeling can also harm content creators, consumers, and overall welfare. The driving force behind these results is creators' strategic response to labeling, which, in turn, depends on how labeling shifts consumers' engagement decisions. While labeling enhances the utility of consumers with strict preferences for content type, incentivizing creators to improve quality, it relaxes competition between creators to attract soft-preference consumers, disincentivizing creators from improving quality. The latter occurs because labeling, by enabling consumers to better distinguish content types, elevates the salience of content type relative to content quality in consumers' engagement decisions. The platform prefers more engagement from human-created content when it monetizes human-created content. However, a high (low) accuracy in detecting AI-generated (human-created) content suppresses the human creator's incentive to improve content quality, diminishing the platform's incentive to label. The results have strong implications for social planners and other stakeholders in social media.

AI.tldr: 本文研究社交媒体平台对AI生成内容进行标注（labeling）的激励问题。研究发现，虽然标注可能带来盈利，但实际上可能损害以广告为驱动的平台的用户参与度；当平台还能从人类创作内容中获利时，其标注激励更弱。标注还可能损害内容创作者、消费者和社会总福利。核心机制是标注改变了创作者的策略性响应：一方面增强严格偏好型消费者的效用并激励创作者提升质量，另一方面削弱了创作者之间争夺软偏好型消费者的竞争，降低了质量提升激励。检测AI生成内容的高准确率会抑制人类创作者的质量提升动力，从而削弱平台的标注激励。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体平台是否有激励对AI生成内容进行标注？标注决策如何受平台商业模式（广告驱动vs.同时从人类内容获利）、消费者异质性偏好、以及检测准确率等因素影响？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI模糊了人类与AI生成内容的界限，引发了消费者对内容类型的不确定性。同时，人类创作内容已成为AI模型训练的关键数据源，成为平台除广告外的额外收入来源。部分平台已开始标注AI生成内容，监管机构也在推动强制标注。然而，标注对平台、创作者、消费者和社会福利的影响尚不明确，需要系统性的理论分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于内容平台经济学模型，考虑消费者对内容类型的异质性偏好（严格偏好vs.软偏好），将内容标注引入消费者参与决策和创作者质量竞争的博弈框架中。
AI.method: 理论模型分析（博弈论方法），构建包含平台标注决策、创作者质量投资决策、消费者内容选择决策的多阶段博弈模型。
AI.findings: （1）标注虽然可能对平台有利可图，但可能损害广告驱动型平台的消费者参与度；（2）当平台还从人类内容获利时，平台标注激励更低；（3）标注可能损害创作者、消费者和社会总福利；（4）标注通过增强严格偏好消费者的效用激励创作者提升质量，但同时削弱了创作者间竞争软偏好消费者的力度，抑制质量提升；（5）检测AI生成内容的高准确率会抑制人类创作者的质量激励，降低平台标注意愿。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了标注AI内容在内容平台中的双重效应机制（激励与竞争抑制），解释了为何看似透明的标注政策可能带来反直觉的负面福利结果，丰富了内容平台治理和AI监管的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社交媒体平台、监管机构（社会规划者）及其他利益相关者提供关于AI内容标注政策的决策参考，揭示了监管强制标注可能带来的意外负面后果，有助于设计更有效的AI内容治理机制。

title: TST Material-Spiritual Framework: A Philosophy of Spirituality

detail.title: TST Material-Spiritual Framework: A Philosophy of Spirituality
detail.abstract: The Material-Spiritual Framework categorizes spiritual traditions by two features: framework status and spiritual orientation. A tradition functions as a rational framework when its organizing structure remains grounded within the Grand Rational Framework; otherwise, it functions as a speculative framework. Each tradition is also categorized as agnostic, non-theistic, or theistic according to its orientation toward the supernatural. Broad religious families may contain several distinct traditions and are therefore classified at the narrowest coherent level. The paper also examines how individuals relate to spiritual traditions through worldview pragmatism and the epistemic classification of individual claims. Worldview pragmatism operates as a person's first lens and may be empirical, rational, or irrational according to how that person generally calibrates belief. Every claim, whether contained within an adopted tradition or formed outside one, must then be evaluated independently against reality through the Idea of Ideas as empirical, rational, or irrational. Irrational is a category, not an insult, and has two subtypes: speculative and disproven. This layered approach distinguishes the status of a tradition from the status of its individual claims and from the posture of the person evaluating them. It avoids treating entire traditions as simply true or false, while also refusing to shield their claims from scrutiny. Personal and cultural interpretations may remain within an individual worldview, but claims presented as descriptions of shared material reality become answerable to the public truth systems, to science, law, and journalism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"物质-精神框架"（Material-Spiritual Framework），通过两个特征（框架地位与精神取向）对精神传统进行分类，并探讨个体如何通过世界观实用主义（worldview pragmatism）和观念之观念（Idea of Ideas）认识论来评估这些传统及其主张。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个系统框架来分类精神传统，并区分传统本身、传统中的个别主张以及评估者个人姿态三者之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么将整个精神传统简单判定为真或假，要么将其完全免受审视，缺乏一种既能区分传统地位与个别主张地位、又能对其进行严格检验的分层方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 物质-精神框架（Material-Spiritual Framework）、大理性框架（Grand Rational Framework）、世界观实用主义、观念之观念（Idea of Ideas）、真值系统（科学、法律、新闻）
AI.method: 概念分析与分类学构建——提出两维度分类体系（框架地位×精神取向），并建立个体主张的三类认识论评估（经验的、理性的、非理性的），再细分非理性为推测性（speculative）与已被证伪（disproven）两类。
AI.findings: 该框架能够区分传统地位、个别主张地位与评估者姿态；避免将整个传统简单判为真伪，同时不让其主张免受审视；主张作为共享物质现实描述时应接受公共真值系统（科学、法律、新闻）的检验。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种精细的分层分类框架，区分了传统的框架地位、精神取向，以及个体主张的认识论状态，弥合了"整体判定真伪"与"完全免于审视"之间的二分。
AI.practical_contributions: 为个人和文化解读保留合理空间，同时为涉及共享物质现实的主张建立可被公共真值系统检验的标准，具有现实生活中的认知与伦理指导意义。

title: Structural Drift Under Asymmetric Conditions: Governing Representations and the Loss of Shared Operational Reality in Eleven Organizational Failures

detail.title: Structural Drift Under Asymmetric Conditions: Governing Representations and the Loss of Shared Operational Reality in Eleven Organizational Failures

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because this study is based exclusively on publicly available documentary sources and does not involve human participants or identifiable personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Across eleven major organizational failures-Three Mile Island, Challenger, Barings, Enron, the subprime crisis, Toyota's recall crisis, Deepwater Horizon, Fukushima Daiichi, the Boeing 737 MAX, NHS operational capacity, and the automotive semiconductor shortage-the information needed to recognize the developing condition was, in every case, present within the system: recorded, published, escalated, or physically demonstrated. This paper argues that what fails in such trajectories is not information but the governing representation: the instrumental representation-census, safety assessment, rating, performance metric-through which planning, assessment, and allocation actually run. Building on a structural account of symmetric organizational design under continuously evolving asymmetric operational conditions, the paper formalizes a mechanism in which divergence arises where the structural interface between design and operational reality fails in its return direction-where operational knowledge does not reach the governing representation-without loss of information; persists where the interfaces at which correction could occur are structurally disabled; is amplified by conduct that is correct by the governing representation; and locks in when the capacity that reversal would require has been consumed under the unrevised representation. The mechanism is made observable by an explicit diagnostic method-a nine-question analytical chain and two falsifiable criteria-applied uniformly across all eleven cases. The comparative record shows the criteria discriminating rather than forcing: ten convergent assignments in differentiated forms, one indeterminate output, and one criterion branch that no case satisfied, reported as an open falsification condition. The framework predicts no triggers and assigns no probabilities; its contribution is structural visibility-making the formation of endogenous risk observable before it becomes measurable.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了11起重大组织失败案例（三里岛、挑战者号、巴林银行、安然、次贷危机、丰田召回、深水地平线、福岛、波音737MAX、NHS运营能力、汽车半导体短缺），提出失败的并非信息本身，而是治理性表征（如普查、安全评估、评级、绩效指标）。论文基于对称组织设计在不对称运营条件下的结构化理论，形式化了一个机制：当设计与运营现实之间的结构界面在"返回方向"上失效——运营知识无法回流至治理性表征——分歧便产生；这种分歧在纠正界面被结构性禁用时持续存在，被"在治理性表征下正确的行为"放大，并在逆转所需能力被消耗后锁定。论文通过九问分析链和两个可证伪标准组成的诊断方法，对全部11个案例进行统一检验，结果显示标准具有区分力：十个收敛指派、一个不确定输出、一个无案例满足的标准分支作为开放证伪条件报告。该框架不做预测、不赋予概率，其贡献在于结构性可见性——使内生风险在可测量之前变得可观察。
AI.research_question: 为什么在重大组织失败中，所需信息始终在场，但组织仍然走向失败？即：信息不缺失的条件下，何种结构性机制导致组织无法识别和纠正正在发展的危机？
AI.motivation: 传统"信息缺失"解释无法回答为何11起重大失败中信息均已存在。作者旨在超越信息视角，转向对组织治理性表征（governing representation）的结构性分析，解释为何组织在信息充分条件下仍系统性失败。
AI.theoretical_framework: 对称组织设计（symmetric organizational design）与不对称运营条件（asymmetric operational conditions）的结构化理论；结构性界面（structural interface）失效机制；内生风险（endogenous risk）理论。
AI.method: 跨案例比较分析：对11起重大组织失败事件统一应用"九问分析链"（nine-question analytical chain）和两个可证伪标准（falsifiable criteria）的诊断方法，进行系统化、可重复的结构性诊断。
AI.findings: （1）11起失败中信息均在场，失败源于治理性表征的失效；（2）机制四步：设计-运营界面返回方向失效→纠正界面被结构性禁用→"表征正确"的行为放大分歧→逆转能力被消耗后锁定；（3）诊断方法具有区分力：10个案例收敛指派、1个不确定输出、1个标准分支无案例满足（作为开放证伪条件）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将组织失败的解释从信息视角转向表征（representation）视角，形式化了治理性表征失效的结构机制；提出"结构性可见性"概念，使内生风险在可测量之前可观察；建立了可证伪的诊断框架，区别于不可证伪的事后叙事。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供实用的九问分析链和两个可证伪标准，可供组织在事前进行结构性诊断；帮助识别纠正界面是否被禁用、运营知识是否回流至治理性表征；不预测触发点或概率，但提升组织对治理性表征盲区的结构性警觉。

title: Uneven Recovery of Service Availability in China’s Domestic Air Transport Network under Prolonged Disruption
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Southwest Jiaotong University

detail.title: Uneven Recovery of Service Availability in China’s Domestic Air Transport Network under Prolonged Disruption
detail.abstract: Prolonged disruptions may substantially weaken the functional performance of air transport systems even when network connectivity remains broadly intact, creating major challenges for post-shock recovery. Using scheduled domestic flight OD data for China from December 2018 to May 2025, this study examines the long-term, multi-stage evolution of the domestic air transport network under the COVID-19 shock. The analysis uses 13 consecutive half-year network snapshots to construct a city-to-city directed weighted network. To assess effective service performance, we develop Functional Flight Accessibility (FFA), which integrates flight frequency, path bottlenecks, and transfer frictions into a unified measure of service capacity. Based on FFA, we derive four node-level resilience indicators: shock depth (Drop), recovery level (Recov), recovery time (Trec), and recovery-path volatility (Vol). The results show that the pandemic primarily weakened the network through declines in flight frequency and functional accessibility rather than through large-scale structural disintegration. Recovery was uneven and did not simply restore the pre-pandemic pattern. Core hubs were generally more resilient, but persistent low-resilience pockets remained concentrated in peripheral feeder cities, border gateways, and single-function tourism cities characterized by weak initial service capacity and limited alternative routes. Scenario simulations further show that, under targeted and cascading disruptions, reinforcement strategies tailored to different resilience types outperform conventional hub-focused approaches by improving overall accessibility and limiting losses in vulnerable cities. These findings suggest that aviation policy should move beyond connectivity preservation toward function-oriented resilience planning, with differentiated support for vulnerable city types and greater attention to service continuity during recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2018年12月至2025年5月中国国内航班OD数据，构建了13个连续半年的城市对有向加权网络，开发了功能航班可达性（FFA）指标及四个节点级韧性指标，研究了COVID-19冲击下国内航空网络的长期多阶段演化。研究发现疫情主要通过航班频率和功能可达性下降而非结构瓦解削弱网络，恢复不均衡，核心枢纽韧性更强，而边缘支线城市、边境门户和单一功能旅游城市持续脆弱；情景模拟表明针对不同韧性类型的强化策略优于传统枢纽导向策略。
AI.research_question: COVID-19冲击下中国国内航空运输网络的长期多阶段演化特征是什么？网络韧性在不同类型城市间如何分布差异？针对不同韧性类型的强化策略能否优于传统枢纽导向策略？
AI.motivation: 即使网络连通性大体保持完整，长期中断也可能显著削弱航空运输系统的功能绩效，给冲击后恢复带来重大挑战。既有研究多关注网络结构层面的韧性，缺乏对功能服务绩效长期演化和恢复过程的系统考察。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络韧性理论；功能可达性理论；复杂网络分析框架
AI.method: 基于中国国内航班OD数据构建13个半年的城市对有向加权网络；开发功能航班可达性（FFA）指标集成航班频率、路径瓶颈和换乘摩擦；推导四个节点级韧性指标（冲击深度Drop、恢复水平Recov、恢复时间Trec、恢复路径波动性Vol）；进行情景模拟比较不同强化策略效果。
AI.findings: （1）疫情主要通过航班频率和功能可达性下降而非大规模结构瓦解削弱网络；（2）恢复不均匀，未简单回归疫情前模式；（3）核心枢纽韧性更强，但边缘支线城市、边境门户和单一功能旅游城市存在持续低韧性口袋，其特征是初始服务能力弱且替代航线有限；（4）针对不同韧性类型的强化策略在提升整体可达性和限制脆弱城市损失方面优于传统枢纽导向策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出功能航班可达性（FFA）这一集成测量框架，将航班频率、路径瓶颈和换乘摩擦统一于服务能力度量中；在此基础上构建包含冲击深度、恢复水平、恢复时间和恢复路径波动性四个维度的节点级韧性指标体系，丰富了对网络韧性多维性的理论理解；揭示了功能韧性而非仅结构连通性在长期恢复中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为航空政策制定提供功能导向的韧性规划建议，主张超越连通性保全转向功能韧性规划；对不同脆弱城市类型（边缘支线、边境门户、旅游城市）提出差异化支持方案；证明针对不同韧性类型的定制化强化策略优于传统枢纽集中策略，为资源配置提供实证依据。

title: When environmental accounting and conflict intersect: Power struggles over water quality and health risk assessment in mining governance
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Newcastle (Australia) - Newcastle Business School

detail.title: When environmental accounting and conflict intersect: Power struggles over water quality and health risk assessment in mining governance
detail.abstract: This paper examines how power operates through environmental risk accounting in a water-pollution conflict involving a multinational mining company in Ghana. Drawing on Beck's (1992, 2016) concept of relations of definitional power, it investigates how environmental and health risks were defined, contested, and governed during disputes over mining-related water pollution. Using a qualitative case study based on interviews and documentary analysis, including difficult-to-obtain competing expert assessment reports, the study finds that authority to define environmental risk was concentrated within a regulatory system that privileged corporate monitoring, technical expertise, and compliance-based measures. Community concerns gained legitimacy only after civil society actors mobilised alternative expertise through a human health risk assessment that challenged official definitions of environmental safety. The findings show that competing assessment frameworks produced different environmental realities through contrasting methodologies. Rather than reducing uncertainty, competing expert assessments intensified struggles over methodological authority and generated conflicting understandings of environmental conditions, causation, and responsibility. The conflict ultimately resulted in organised irresponsibility. Although some contamination concerns were recognised, many historical pollution claims remained unresolved, and the contamination identified could not be conclusively linked to the mining company. Consequently, accountability could not be assigned despite sustained contestation. The paper contributes to critical accounting research by demonstrating– that environmental and health-risk assessment functions as a political technology through which actors seek to establish authoritative definitions of environmental reality. It further develops Beck’s concept of relations of definitional power by showing how institutional arrangements governing environmental knowledge production can reproduce existing accountability relations despite sustained contestation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过加纳一家跨国矿业公司涉及的水污染冲突案例，考察权力如何通过环境风险会计发挥作用。基于贝克（Beck）的"定义权力关系"概念，研究发现环境风险的定义权集中在偏爱企业监测、技术专家和合规措施的监管体系中，社区关切在民间社会动员替代性专业知识后才获得合法性。相互竞争的评估框架通过不同方法论产生了不同的环境现实，最终导致"有组织的无责任"，即尽管持续争辩，问责仍无法落实。
AI.research_question: 权力如何通过环境风险会计在跨国矿业公司的水污染冲突中运作？环境与健康风险如何被定义、争议和治理？
AI.motivation: 环境风险会计在冲突情境中如何既塑造又限制问责的空间，现有研究对此理解不足，尤其是对权力在风险定义过程中的作用缺乏深入探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝克（Beck, 1992, 2016）的"定义权力关系"（relations of definitional power）概念
AI.method: 定性案例研究，基于访谈和文献分析，包括难以获取的相互竞争的专家评估报告
AI.findings: 1）环境风险的定义权集中在偏好企业监测、技术专长和合规措施的监管体系中；2）社区关切仅在社会行动者动员替代性专业知识后才获得合法性；3）相互竞争的评估框架通过不同方法论产生不同环境现实；4）竞争性专家评估加剧了方法论权威的斗争，而非减少不确定性；5）冲突最终导致"有组织的无责任"——历史污染索赔悬而未决，污染无法确凿归因于矿业公司，问责无法落实。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）展示了环境与健康风险评估作为政治技术的运作机制，行动者借此建立对环境现实的权威定义；2）发展了贝克的定义权力关系概念，展示了管理环境知识生产的制度安排如何在持续争议中再现现有问责关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了环境风险会计中制度性权力不对称的问题，为政策制定者和监管者反思现行风险评估和问责体系提供实证依据，凸显了替代性专业知识在挑战企业主导风险评估中的关键作用。

title: The Wishart-Savage Transition Matrix for StructuralBreak Detection in Covariance Networks
affiliations: American International University Kuwait, Bahir Dar University and Bahir Dar University

detail.title: The Wishart-Savage Transition Matrix for StructuralBreak Detection in Covariance Networks
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a novel, non-linear Bayesian sequential detection framework to identify real-time structural breaks in high-dimensional financial risk networks, termed the Wishart-Savage sliding transition operator. By operating across adjacent, sliding time windows, our methodology tracks the recursive geometric deformation of the conditional precision matrix without relying on latent random walk processes or non-linear filtering approximations.Leveraging information-theoretic foundations, we derive an exact analytical closed-form expression for the Kullback-Leibler entropy gradient between successive multivariate Wishart states. This exact formulation eliminates the computational curse of dimensionality, entirely bypassing the stochastic simulation loops inherent in standard Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) frameworks. Under the null hypothesis of structural stability, we establishthe asymptotic convergence of our test statistic toward a Chi-squared distribution via the Wilks principle, enabling the formulation of an exact analytical decision threshold. We apply our framework to a systemic banking network consisting of p = 49 global financial institutions spanning the 2018-2024 macroeconomic cycles. The entropic signal successfully captures continuous non-linear topological mutations, identifying a critical structural breakpointon February 13, 2020 (τ ∗ = 484). Crucially, this signal acts as an early warning indicator, identifying the systemic collapse and architectural contraction of the international banking corridor weeks prior to the explicit COVID-19 market panic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的非线性贝叶斯序贯检测框架（Wishart-Savage滑动转移算子），用于在高维金融风险网络中实时识别结构性断点。该方法通过相邻滑动时间窗口追踪条件精度矩阵的递归几何变形，并基于信息论推导出Kullback-Leibler熵梯度的精确解析闭式解，避免了传统MCMC随机模拟的计算负担。将该框架应用于2018-2024年间49家全球金融机构的系统性银行网络，成功在2020年2月13日识别出关键结构性断点，并可提前数周预警COVID-19市场恐慌。
AI.research_question: 如何在高维金融风险网络中实现实时、精确且计算高效的结构性断点检测？
AI.motivation: 传统结构性断点检测方法依赖于隐随机游走过程或非线性滤波近似，且标准MCMC框架面临维数诅咒和计算负担。需要一种无需随机模拟、具有精确解析形式的实时检测方法，以提升高维金融风险网络的监控能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯序贯检测理论、Wishart分布理论、Kullback-Leibler散度/信息论、Wilks原理（渐近卡方分布）、精度矩阵/几何变形分析
AI.method: 提出Wishart-Savage滑动转移算子：在相邻滑动时间窗口上运行，推导Wishart状态间KL熵梯度的精确解析闭式表达式，构建检验统计量，利用Wilks原理建立渐近卡方分布下的解析决策阈值，应用于49家全球银行的系统性网络实证分析。
AI.findings: 该方法成功识别出2020年2月13日（τ*=484）的关键结构性断点；熵信号能够捕捉连续非线性拓扑突变，并在COVID-19市场恐慌爆发前数周就发出早期预警，识别出国际银行走廊的系统性崩溃和架构收缩。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将Wishart状态间的KL熵梯度推导为精确解析闭式形式，消除了MCMC随机模拟的需求；通过Wilks原理建立了渐近卡方分布的解析决策阈值，拓展了贝叶斯序贯检测理论在高维金融网络中的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融监管机构提供了一种计算高效、无需模拟的实时结构性断点检测工具；该框架能作为早期预警指标，在系统性危机爆发前提前识别金融网络的结构性恶化，有助于提升金融风险监测和宏观审慎监管能力。

title: Derivation and external validation of machine learning-based prediction for clinically significant prostate cancer in men with PSA ≤10 ng/mL: a multicenter study across Spain, Germany, and China
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Peking University - Peking University First Hospital, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Peking University - Peking University First Hospital and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Derivation and external validation of machine learning-based prediction for clinically significant prostate cancer in men with PSA ≤10 ng/mL: a multicenter study across Spain, Germany, and China
detail.abstract: ObjectivesAccurate risk stratification for clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa, ISUP grade group >1) in men with prostate-specific antigen (PSA) ≤10 ng/mL remains challenging, leading to unnecessary biopsies. However, the European Association of Urology (EAU) risk matrix offers limited specificity. This study is to assess the performance of machine learning (ML) models versus the EAU risk matrix for reducing unnecessary biopsies.MethodsThis retrospective multicenter study included patients with PSA ≤10 ng/mL and underwent mpMRI followed by prostate biopsy across centers in Spain, Germany, and China. The primary end point was csPCa detection. Ten machine learning models were trained and validated using ten-fold cross-validation and two external cohorts. Model performance was assessed by area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), calibration, and decision curve analysis, with comparisons against the EAU risk matrix.ResultsAmong the 2,763 patients, 1,587 from the discovery cohort were randomly split into training (n=1,112) and internal validation (n=475), while the remaining 1,176 came from two external test cohorts (PKCH, n=206; PKFH, n=970). The csPCa detection rates were 39.93% (training), 39.79% (internal validation), 42.72% (PKCH), and 44.64% (PKFH) for the respective cohorts. The Neural Network (NN) model using age, PSA, prostate volume, and PI-RADS achieved the highest AUCs (0.781–0.863) across validation and external test cohorts. At 95% sensitivity, the NN significantly outperformed the EAU scheme in specificity (37.8-55.1% vs 24.1-42.6%, P<0.001). This marked improvement successfully averted 23.8% to 32.5% of unnecessary biopsies, reduced the overdiagnosis of indolent cancer by up to 36.8%, and corrected 29.2% of csPCa cases misclassified as low-risk by the EAU risk matrix.ConclusionsWe developed and externally validated an NN-based risk stratification model for patients with PSA ≤10 ng/mL. This tool enables individualized assessment of csPCa risk and may support clinical decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并外部验证了基于神经网络（NN）的风险分层模型，用于PSA≤10 ng/mL患者的临床显著性前列腺癌（csPCa）检测。该模型在多个验证队列中取得了0.781-0.863的AUC，在95%敏感性下特异性显著优于EAU风险矩阵（37.8-55.1% vs 24.1-42.6%），可避免23.8%-32.5%的不必要活检，减少高达36.8%的惰性癌症过度诊断，并纠正29.2%被EAU风险矩阵错误分类为低风险的csPCa病例。
AI.research_question: 对于PSA≤10 ng/mL且接受mpMRI和前列腺活检的患者，机器学习模型相较于EAU风险矩阵能否更有效地进行csPCa风险分层，从而减少不必要的活检？
AI.motivation: PSA≤10 ng/mL的男性中进行csPCa的准确风险分层仍具挑战性，导致大量不必要的活检。EAU风险矩阵特异性有限，需要更精确的风险分层工具来改善临床决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机器学习（ML）的风险预测理论与EAU风险分层框架的对比分析。
AI.method: 回顾性多中心研究，纳入来自西班牙、德国和中国的2,763例PSA≤10 ng/mL且接受mpMRI后活检的患者。训练10种机器学习模型，采用十折交叉验证和两个外部队列验证。模型性能通过AUC、校准曲线和决策曲线分析评估，并与EAU风险矩阵进行比较。
AI.findings: 基于年龄、PSA、前列腺体积和PI-RADS的神经网络（NN）模型在所有验证队列中取得了最高的AUC（0.781-0.863）。在95%敏感性下，NN模型的特异性显著优于EAU方案（37.8-55.1% vs 24.1-42.6%，P<0.001），避免了23.8%-32.5%的不必要活检，将惰性癌症过度诊断减少36.8%，并纠正了29.2%被EAU风险矩阵误分类的csPCa病例。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了机器学习模型（尤其是神经网络）在PSA≤10 ng/mL患者中用于csPCa风险分层的优越性，拓展了人工智能在泌尿肿瘤风险预测领域的应用理论，表明ML模型可显著优于传统临床风险分层工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个经过外部验证的NN-based风险分层工具，可帮助临床医生对PSA≤10 ng/mL患者进行个性化csPCa风险评估，减少不必要的前列腺活检和惰性癌症的过度诊断，为临床决策提供支持。

title: Closing the Compounding Seat Equilibrium Charge-Setting on a Destructible Seat

detail.title: Closing the Compounding Seat Equilibrium Charge-Setting on a Destructible Seat
detail.abstract: A monitor whose seat compounds and whose own inattention can destroy it grows more attentive as it grows more prudent: the classical penalty paradox inverts. That is a decision problem's result-the charge is a parameter of the environment, and it leaves open the question a paradox about penalties must eventually answer, which is whether any penalty-setter would choose to impose such a charge on such a monitor. This paper closes the game. A charge-setter commits to a scalar charge and the monitor best-responds by the companion paper's correspondence, imported unchanged; because that correspondence is genuinely multivalued on a band of charges, every equilibrium statement here names its selection. Existence is not a formality and is not assumed: attainment is generic on the destructible seat, where the band is extinct and the response continuous, and can fail on the insulated benchmark at one edge of the open band and only under a selection that abandons the engaged branch there-a dichotomy the paper characterizes rather than conventions away. The closure's economics is then a deterrence story, because a charge-setter who values only vigilance has no reason to charge at all. Its central finding is that the seat decides which margin absorbs the monitor's prudence. On an insulated seat the paradox survives the closure but migrates: equilibrium vigilance does not fall-the charge-setter's own penalty does, and the deterrence it purchases with it. On a destructible seat the reversal survives and the charge-setter takes both margins. The two seats are the endpoints of one rotation, and one law crosses the whole construction unbroken-equilibrium vigilance never falls in the monitor's prudence, for an exact reason the paper identifies and at a boundary it characterizes. Welfare inverts the moral. The monitor's own tail, which aligns its behavior, is precisely what lets a charge-setter charge more before it disengages; the tail subsidizes the charge-setter, and a planner who counts the monitor's welfare pays for the subsidy. In proportional terms the closure costs more on the destructible seat than on the insulated one, at every deterrence family and either court tested. And a planner who counts the monitor heavily enough does not moderate the penalty but abandons it, at a boundary fixed by the charge-setter's own appetite for the first unit of charge and signed by the seat-earlier over the insulated monitor, later over the exposed one. The failures the programme studies require no one to collude. On the seats where the mechanism lives, they turn out to require no one to be less vigilant either.

AI.tldr: 本文将一个监控者（monitor）的惩罚悖论博弈封闭为完整博弈：惩罚设定者（charge-setter）承诺一个标量惩罚，监控者根据伴随论文的对应关系最优响应。论文证明均衡存在并非形式问题——在可破坏席位（destructible seat）上实现是普遍的，在绝缘基准（insulated benchmark）上可能失败。核心发现是席位类型决定监控者审慎性吸收在哪一边际上：绝缘席位上悖论迁移但均衡监控力度不下降（下降的是惩罚设定者自身的惩罚），可破坏席位上逆转持续且惩罚设定者占据两个边际。福利分析表明监控者的尾部风险补贴了惩罚设定者，且规划者若足够重视监控者福利会放弃惩罚而非调和它。
AI.research_question: 惩罚设定者是否会选择对监控者施加惩罚？在封闭博弈中，惩罚悖论是否存续？均衡存在性条件是什么？席位类型如何影响悖论的形态和福利结果？
AI.motivation: 经典的惩罚悖论（penalty paradox）表明惩罚会降低监控者的注意力，但此前的模型将惩罚视为环境参数，未回答惩罚设定者是否真的会选择施加惩罚这一核心问题。本文通过封闭博弈来回答这一开放问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 惩罚悖论、博弈论均衡分析、最优响应对应关系、威慑理论（deterrence）、福利经济学
AI.method: 理论建模与博弈论分析：构建惩罚设定者与监控者的两阶段博弈，惩罚设定者承诺标量惩罚，监控者依据伴随论文的最优响应对应关系（multivalued correspondence）做出回应。分析两种席位类型（可破坏席位与绝缘席位）下的均衡存在性、选择依赖性与福利性质。
AI.findings: （1）均衡存在不是形式问题：可破坏席位上实现是普遍的（响应连续），绝缘席位上在开带的边缘可能失败，且仅当选择放弃参与分支时。（2）均衡监控力度在监控者审慎性中永不下降——这是一条贯穿整个构造的定律。（3）绝缘席位上悖论存续但迁移：下降的是惩罚设定者自身的惩罚；可破坏席位上逆转持续且惩罚设定者占据两个边际。（4）监控者的尾部风险补贴惩罚设定者，使其能施加更高惩罚。（5）规划者若足够重视监控者福利，会放弃惩罚而非调和，边界由惩罚设定者对首单位惩罚的胃口决定。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将惩罚悖论从部分均衡分析提升为完整博弈分析，回答了惩罚设定者是否会选择施加惩罚这一经典问题。（2）刻画了均衡存在性的精确条件，揭示了选择的角色（every equilibrium names its selection）。（3）发现"均衡监控力度在监控者审慎性中永不下降"这一跨构造普遍定律。（4）区分了两种席位类型导致的悖论迁移与逆转的不同形态。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为监管者/惩罚设定者提供关于何时施加惩罚、施加何种程度惩罚的指导。（2）揭示监控者自身尾部风险对惩罚可行性的补贴机制，提醒规划者正视这一隐性成本。（3）表明在重视监控者福利的情形下，最优政策可能是放弃惩罚而非温和惩罚。

detail.title: Body mass, adiposity, and operated-hip loading during walking 1–6 years after total hip replacement: a cross-sectional analysis
detail.abstract: Background. Higher body mass is widely assumed to increase mechanical loading of the replaced hip after total hip replacement, but how body-mass index (BMI) relates to operated-limb loading during walking, and through what pathway, is not well characterised.Methods. Cross-sectional secondary analysis of an open motion-capture dataset (dual force plates). In 92 patients with a unilateral total hip replacement, the operated-limb vertical ground-reaction-force loading rate during level walking was regressed on BMI, adjusted for age, sex, time since surgery, and self-selected gait speed. A gait-speed mediation pathway and an E-value for unmeasured confounding were examined. The analysis was underpowered (0.30) and treated as exploratory.Findings. Higher BMI was associated with a lower operated-hip vertical loading rate (adjusted β = −2.85 per 5 kg/m², 95% confidence interval −5.64 to −0.07; P=0.045; model R²=0.39). The association was graded across World Health Organization BMI categories (P<0.001) and was unchanged when bilateral patients were included. Approximately 18% of the association was mediated by slower self-selected gait speed. An E-value of 1.50 (confidence limit 1.06) indicated that only modest unmeasured confounding could explain the result.Interpretation. In this exploratory analysis, higher body mass was associated with lower rather than higher operated-hip loading rate during walking, partly because heavier patients walked more slowly. The finding is hypothesis-generating, not a basis for clinical decisions, and should be confirmed in an adequately powered, prospective cohort with joint-level kinetics.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于开放动作捕捉数据集（双测力台），对92名单侧全髋关节置换术后患者进行横断面二次分析，发现较高BMI与术后髋关节的垂直地面反作用力加载率更低相关（而非更高），部分原因在于体重较重的患者步行速度更慢。该关联具有分级特征，约18%由步速介导，但研究统计功效不足（0.30），仅作为探索性假设生成，不能作为临床决策依据。
AI.research_question: 在全髋关节置换术后，BMI如何影响手术侧肢体在行走过程中的加载负荷（垂直地面反作用力加载率），以及这种关联的作用路径是什么？
AI.motivation: 更高的体重通常被认为会增加置换髋关节的机械负荷，但BMI与术后手术侧肢体行走加载之间的关系及其作用机制尚未被充分阐明。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机械负荷理论（体重增加会增加关节负荷）；步速中介效应框架；未测量混杂的E值敏感性分析框架。
AI.method: 横断面二次分析，使用开放动作捕捉数据集（双测力台）；对92名单侧全髋关节置换术患者，将手术侧肢体行走时的垂直地面反作用力加载率对BMI进行回归分析，调整年龄、性别、手术时间及自选步速；检验步速中介路径和E值以评估未测量混杂；分析功效为0.30，作为探索性研究。
AI.findings: 较高BMI与较低的手术侧髋关节垂直加载率相关（调整β = -2.85每5 kg/m²，95%CI -5.64至-0.07，P=0.045，模型R²=0.39）；该关联在WHO BMI分类中呈分级趋势（P<0.001）；纳入双侧患者结果不变；约18%的关联由较慢的自选步速介导；E值为1.50（置信限1.06），表明仅需适度的未测量混杂即可解释该结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"更高体重必然增加置换髋关节机械负荷"的传统假设，提出体重升高可能通过减缓步速而间接降低关节加载率，为理解肥胖与全髋关节置换术后生物力学关系提供了新的机制视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果具有假设生成性质，提示在指导术后康复和体重管理策略时，不能简单假定减重必然降低关节负荷；需由充足功效的前瞻性队列研究加以确证后再考虑临床应用。
